items.text: Inzwai shoko iri, imi mhou dzeBhashani paGomo reSamaria,
uye vanopwanya vanoshayiwa muchiti kuvarume venyu, "Tiunzirei zvokunwa."
Ishe Jehovha apika noutsvene hwake achiti,
Pisai chingwa chine mbiriso sechibayiro chokuvonga
muzvirumbidze pamusoro pezvipiriso zvenyu zvokupa nokuzvisarudzira,
"Ndakakupai matumbu asina chinhu mumaguta makuru ose
uye ndikakushayisai chingwa mumaguta maduku ose,
kuti isanaya kwasara mwedzi mitatu kuti mukohwe.
Vanhu vakadzedzereka vachibva kune rimwe guta vachienda kune rimwe kundotsvaka mvura,
asi havana kuwana yaivaringana kuti vanwe,
"Kakawanda kwazvo ndakarova mapindu neminda yenyu yemizambiringa,
Mhashu dzakaparadza mionde nemiti yenyu yemiorivhi,
Ndakazadza mhino dzenyu nokunhuhwa kwemisasa yenyu,
Makanga makaita sorukuni runotsva, rwabviswa mumoto,
gadzirira kusangana naMwari wako, iwe Israeri."

items.text: Inzwai shoko iri, imi imba yaIsraeri, kuchema uku kwandinoita pamusoro penyu:

items.text: Izvi ndizvo zvandakaratidzwa naIshe Jehovha: Akanga achigadzirira chimokoto chemhashu mushure mokukohwewa kwomugove wamambo uye mumera wechipiri uchangobuda.
Dzakati dzapedza zvose zvaiva munyika, ndakadanidzira ndichiti, "Ishe Jehovha chikanganwirai henyu! Ko, Jakobho angararame sei? Muduku kwazvo!"
Izvi ndizvo zvandakaratidzwa naIshe Jehovha: Ishe Jehovha akanga achidanidzira kuti pave nokutonga nomoto; wakaomesa gungwa rakadzika uye ukaparadza nyika.
Ipapo ndakadanidzira ndichiti, "Ishe Jehovha, ndinokukumbirai, imbomirai henyu. Ko, Jakobho angararame sei? Muduku kwazvo!"
Izvi ndizvo zvaakandiratidza: Jehovha akanga akamira pamadziro akanga akavakwa zvakaenzaniswa nerwodzi, ane rwodzi rwokuyeresa muruoko rwake.
Ipapo Jehovha akati, "Tarira, ndichaisa rwodzi rwokuyeresa pakati pavanhu vangu vaIsraeri, handichavaponesazve.
uye nzvimbo tsvene dzaIsraeri dzichaitwa matongo;
Ipapo Amazia muprista weBheteri akatumira shoko kuna Jerobhoamu mambo weIsraeri achiti, "Amosi akaita rangano yokukumukirai pakati chaipo pemwoyo weIsraeri. Nyika haigoni kugamuchira mashoko ake ose.
Nokuti izvi ndizvo zviri kutaurwa naAmosi:
Ipapo Amazia akati kuna Amosi, "Ibva muno, iwe muoni! Dzokera kunyika yeJudha. Uzviwanire zvokudya zvako ikoko, uchiprofita ikoko.
Usaprofitazve paBheteri, nokuti iyi ndiyo nzvimbo tsvene yamambo uye netemberi youmambo."
Amosi akapindura Amazia achiti, "Ndakanga ndisiri muprofita, kana mwanakomana womuprofita, asi ndaiva mufudzi nomutariri wemionde yemisikamo.
Asi Jehovha akanditora kubva paufudzi hwamakwai akati kwandiri, 'Enda uprofite kuvanhu vangu Israeri.'
